name: Discord
summary:
Discord’s favicon is the Clyde mark discord.com publishes for the web app. Download links appear only for files that were saved, and sizes were read from those files.

Checked 12 November 2026 against discord.com. HTML came from https://discord.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/62fddf0fde45a8baedcc7ee5_847541504914fd33810e70a0ea73177e%20(2)-1.png; apple-touch-icon → https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/6266bc493fb42d4e27bb8393_847541504914fd33810e70a0ea73177e.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/6266bc493fb42d4e27bb8393_847541504914fd33810e70a0ea73177e.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 285478 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48, 256×256.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/6266bc493fb42d4e27bb8393_847541504914fd33810e70a0ea73177e.ico.

Brand colour #161cbb comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: png-32x32-02.png at 32×32 (png, 557 bytes) from https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/62fddf0fde45a8baedcc7ee5_847541504914fd33810e70a0ea73177e%20(2)-1.png.
